en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2580 - Abu Sa'id al-Mukari narrated from Abu Abdullah (as), who said:

"Indeed, Allah (swt), the Almighty, has exempted women from four things: raising their voices in the Talbiyah, running between Safa and Marwah (meaning brisk walking), entering the Ka'bah, and touching the Black Stone."
